The '''Plavonia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Plavonian starfish]].<ref name="Lords of the Expanse" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Plavonia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and which placed it in grid square J-18.<ref name="TEA" />
